components.css: .ds-module-nav { width: 220px; background: #26332D; color: #F8F6EF; padding: 18px 16px; font-family: sans-serif; }.ds-module-nav strong { display:block; font-size:18px; }.ds-module-nav small { color:#D0D4D1; }.ds-module-nav hr { border:0; border-top:1px solid #657168; margin:14px 0; }.ds-module-nav label { display:block; margin:8px 0; }.ds-module-nav input { accent-color:#477653; }

components.name: Standard Select
components.description: Native Streamlit select control for module algorithms and view choices.
components.css: .ds-select { display:grid; gap:6px; max-width:260px; color:#26332D; font-family:sans-serif; }.ds-select span { font-size:13px; font-weight:600; }.ds-select select { width:100%; height:38px; border:1px solid #9AA69B; border-radius:4px; background:#F8F6EF; color:#26332D; padding:6px 10px; }.ds-select select:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #477653; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Linked Data Table
components.description: A full-width, index-free, single-row selection table linked to the network.
components.css: .ds-table { width:100%; background:#F8F6EF; color:#26332D; font-family:Arial,sans-serif; font-size:12px; }.ds-table table { width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; }.ds-table th,.ds-table td { text-align:left; padding:8px 10px; border-bottom:1px solid #DCD9CF; }.ds-table th { font-weight:600; }.ds-table tr.selected { background:#E9E4D5; outline:2px solid #C75B3B; outline-offset:-2px; }

components.name: Network Plate
components.description: Registered graph canvas with circular nodes, weighted edges, persistent legend, and a clay selection state.
components.html: Comunidad 1Comunidad 2Seleccionada
components.css: .ds-network { max-width:620px; background:#F8F6EF; padding:12px; color:#26332D; font-family:Arial,sans-serif; }.ds-plate { position:relative; height:300px; border-bottom:1px solid #DCD9CF; }.ds-node { position:absolute; width:22px; height:22px; border-radius:50%; border:2px solid #F8F6EF; }.ds-node.green { left:22%; top:46%; background:#477653; }.ds-node.blue { left:52%; top:24%; background:#557D9C; }.ds-node.selected { left:70%; top:62%; background:#A07945; border:3px solid #C75B3B; }.ds-edge { position:absolute; height:2px; background:#9AA69B; transform-origin:left center; }.ds-edge.one { left:24%; top:49%; width:31%; transform:rotate(-34deg); }.ds-edge.two { left:54%; top:29%; width:23%; transform:rotate(55deg); background:#477653; }.ds-legend { display:flex; gap:18px; padding-top:10px; font-size:11px; }.ds-legend span { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:5px; }.dot { width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%; }.dot.green{background:#477653}.dot.blue{background:#557D9C}.dot.clay{background:#C75B3B}

components.name: Algorithm Comparison
components.description: Compact horizontal comparison chart for modularity or maximum-flow results.
components.css: .ds-comparison { background:#F8F6EF; margin:0; padding:12px; color:#26332D; font-family:Arial,sans-serif; }.ds-comparison figcaption { font-size:16px; font-weight:600; margin-bottom:10px; }.ds-bar { display:grid; grid-template-columns:110px 1fr 58px; align-items:center; gap:8px; min-height:28px; font-size:12px; }.ds-bar i { height:14px; background:#477653; }.ds-bar:nth-of-type(3) i { background:#A07945; }.ds-bar:nth-of-type(4) i { background:#557D9C; }.ds-bar b { font-weight:600; }

narrative.overview:
OptiFin presents financial-network algorithms as restrained, comparable scientific plates. Paper-like surfaces carry graphite text, leaf-green structure, and a small clay-red signal for selection or bottlenecks. The interface stays native to Streamlit: the app uses familiar navigation and controls rather than recreating dashboard furniture.

The main visual priority is the registered network. Its node positions remain stable across supported states, graph scale stays comparable within a view, and persistent legends explain community or node-type encoding. Tables sit with the graph or directly below it as part of the analysis, not as detached decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Paper ground with graphite and muted green labels
Leaf-green as the primary analytical structure
Clay red reserved for active or critical state

rules.name: The Restrained Signal Rule
rules.body: Clay red, selected borders, and critical edges communicate state; they do not replace labels or legends.

rules.name: The Units Stay Visible Rule
rules.body: Financial figures use explicit `$`, USD captions, and 0–3 decimal precision appropriate to modularity or flow rather than relying on abbreviated numeric treatment.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Use no ambient shadow on the dashboard. Graph nodes use a paper border to separate them from the plot ground and a clay outline for selection.

rules.name: The Direct Geometry Rule
rules.body: Preserve circular nodes, horizontal legends, and thin borders. Do not introduce cards, ornamental containers, or hard offset shadows.

dos: Do keep node positions stable by supplying the same graph layout seed or explicit layer positions.
Do pair graph state with text and a persistent legend.
Do label every analytical dataset as synthetic.
Do keep community results as review indicators, never accusations or determinations.
Do use standard Streamlit controls and Python/Plotly implementations.
Do place result tables beside or immediately below the graph they explain.
donts: Don't float summary metrics as detached decorative cards.
Don't replace graph colors with color alone; supply labels, captions, legends, or table text.
Don't use hard offset shadows or a dark app shell.
Don't introduce a new frontend stack or custom icon glyph system.
Don't canonize the mock's botanical eyebrow or decorative kicker treatments; they are not shipped by the application.
